description: Remove one keyframe from an interpolable. The time must match an existing keyframe exactly — read the times back from studio_timeline_get_state rather than recomputing them, since they are stored as floats. Removing the last keyframe leaves the interpolable in place with no keyframes; drop it with studio_timeline_remove_interpolable. Requires the Timeline plugin.

time.description: the keyframe's exact time in seconds, as read from studio_timeline_get_state

output.description: the interpolable with its remaining keyframes, same shape as one entry of studio_timeline_get_state's 'interpolables'
